reason: capacity mining: PhysicsLab harness ownership can outlive an externally destroyed canonical realization

payload.title: PhysicsLabStudioHarness can retain stale ownership after callers destroy the returned realization
payload.reproducibleInvariant: On current main, active = PhysicsLabStudioHarness.start(workspace) returns the raw RealizedLab, including active.destroy. Calling active.destroy() destroys the realized model/runtime but does not clear the harness-local current reference. PhysicsLabStudioHarness.get() therefore still returns active, and a subsequent start(workspace) rejects with 'PhysicsLabStudioHarness already running' even though the physical authority root is gone. This stale-ownership wedge also survives the open PR #307 ownership test because that patch covers stop()-owned destruction, not destruction through the raw returned handle.
evidence: PhysicsLabStudioHarness.start stores current = PhysicsLabRealizer.realize(targetParent) and returns that same raw object.
The RealizedLab contract exposes destroy(), and PhysicsLabRealizer.destroy tears down model/runtime without notifying PhysicsLabStudioHarness.
PhysicsLabStudioHarness.get returns current without validating physical/runtime liveness; start rejects any non-nil current before realization.
Open PR #307 explicitly tests duplicate start, stop-owned destroy, double-stop, and restart ordering; its published scope does not cover a caller invoking destroy() on the start() result.
Open-PR duplicate search for PhysicsLab/harness destroy/stale/ownership/lifecycle found no existing repair for this raw-handle lifetime split.

proposedLane.scope: Centralize canonical realization destruction under the harness or reconcile current against realization liveness before get/start, with a source-level regression for external-handle destruction. Preserve fail-closed server ownership and do not make Workspace canonical truth.

payload.guardrail: Do not start a competing authority implementation while #316/#307/#300 and the current diagnostics/authority train are still active. Consume this only as a bounded follow-up once the active train has a clear integration point; require exact-head source tests and independent review. No Roblox Studio or two-client evidence is claimed by this source-level finding.
payload.duplicateCheck: Distinct from evt-20260811-084830-q5x8n3z2-authority-workspace-parent: that finding concerns where the canonical root may be realized; this finding concerns harness ownership remaining live after the returned realization is independently destroyed.
